title: Machine Learning Identifies ICU Outcome Predictors in a Multicenter COVID-19 Cohort.
summary: The v1 Research Square report describes 1,039 patients across retrospective and prospective cohorts and reports model-based ICU outcome predictors. These are observational associations; the model does not establish treatment effects or improved patient outcomes.
ai_technology: Explainable machine-learning models analyzed a multicenter COVID-19 registry to identify predictors of ICU outcomes and survival.
organization: University Hospital; University Hospitals Tübingen; participating hospital centers
